A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same teacher-guided 3D Gaussian diffusion framework. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary materials are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original ShapeNet-SRN and RealEstate10K reconstruction results, architectural and loss ablations, and additional-view guidance experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds Co3D hydrant evaluation and further teacher-size and cycle-consistency controls.

M1.justification: Teacher bootstrapping, multi-step denoising, rendering losses, cycle consistency, and additional-view guidance remain unchanged. Medium/Large terminology clarifies existing architectures; the added teacher-size experiment applies the same method.

E1.justification: Alongside the retained ShapeNet-SRN cars/chairs and RealEstate10K scenes, v3 trains and evaluates on Co3D hydrants (Section 6.1). This extends object-level coverage from synthetic objects to a real-captured object domain, although only one Co3D category is tested.

E2.justification: The main benchmark comparator sets are unchanged. Co3D reuses ViewSet Diffusion and Splatter Image, while Splatter Image (Medium) renames v1's existing feedforward control. Teacher-size and longer-training controls do not introduce different comparison algorithms.

E3.justification: v3 adds a medium-sized-teacher experiment and a control that further fine-tunes Splatter Image for 1000 epochs. Existing benchmark splits, resolutions, metrics, and view-selection procedures remain unchanged. Newly disclosed student training durations do not establish a revision to its earlier training protocol.

E4.justification: Table 4 adds medium-teacher diffusion and a control using cycle consistency only in stage I. Section 8 adds an extra-training check for Splatter Image. Conversely, v1's comparison of timestep ranges [0,T] and [t*,T] disappears; the loss-choice and loss-weighting ablations remain.

E5.justification: v3 newly states that Co3D scores for ViewSet Diffusion and the proposed model are averaged over seeds and test data. v1 contains no corresponding seed-aggregation reporting. Neither version supplies seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: New Co3D results are 22.34 PSNR, 0.82 SSIM, and 0.149 LPIPS. Table 4 adds novel-view PSNR results of 21.7506 for the medium-teacher configuration and 24.6897 for stage-I-only cycle consistency, while removing timestep-range results. Main benchmark scores remain unchanged; the 25.26 guidance-table entry already appeared in v1 Table 9.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, noise-threshold assumption, loss equations, and guidance equations remain equivalent, including Equations 1–12. No theorem, proof, or substantive mathematical derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The central claims remain training 3D diffusion from 2D supervision using noisy teachers and multi-step denoising, improving teacher reconstructions, and incorporating additional views through guidance. The rewritten abstract and added experiments do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: v3 extends the architectural interpretation to improvements with both medium and large teachers and attributes negligible gains from additional teacher fine-tuning to convergence. The stated limitations concerning pixel-aligned Gaussians and insufficient coverage of occluded regions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 8 newly specifies 5000 bootstrapping epochs and 1000 fine-tuning epochs. Section 4.1 clarifies teacher/student model-size usage, and the abstract adds a project-page link. Hardware, batch sizes, optimizer, and noise-schedule details are retained, with some moved into the appendix.

R1.justification: v3 adds DMV3D and several reconstruction/SLAM references, replaces v1's SDEdit-linked Yi citation with Meng et al.'s SDEdit, and removes Tweedie-related references. The substantive positioning against deterministic reconstruction and other approaches to 2D-supervised 3D diffusion remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract and substantial introduction passages are rewritten to foreground training with 2D supervision. v3 standardizes Medium/Large terminology, reorganizes the experimental setup around model-size clarification, and relocates miscellaneous implementation prose into the appendix. This substantially revises the opening narrative despite stable scientific claims.

P2.justification: Figure 3(a) is replaced with teacher-size comparisons, Figures 1 and 5 gain size labels, and a Co3D table is added. Table 4 is regrouped, while the main guidance table incorporates an existing appendix row. Most remaining figures and table designs are retained.

improvement.justification: The Co3D experiment and teacher-size and extra-training controls strengthen validation, while clearer model-size labels and training-duration disclosures improve transparency. Removing the timestep-range ablation loses useful support for the noise-threshold choice, and Co3D protocol and uncertainty reporting remain limited. The additions nevertheless provide a modest net improvement in evidential support and clarity.
